meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理 Git 提交、改写历史、调查代码变更记录。它会先检查仓库状态，再按你的要求执行提交、变基、查找等操作，并给出详细报告。
howto.when: 当你需要提交代码、查看谁改了某行代码、或想整理 Git 提交历史时触发。不要用于普通代码编辑，除非你明确要求 Git 操作。

say.text: 帮我提交这次修改，分成两个原子提交。
say.note: Claude 会分析改动，按功能拆分成多个提交。

say.text: 谁最后修改了 src/main.js 的第 10 到 20 行？
say.note: Claude 会用 git blame 找出责任人。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个。
say.note: Claude 会执行交互式变基并自动压缩。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage Git commits, rewrite history, and investigate code change history. It first checks the repository state, then executes commits, rebases, lookups, etc., as you request, and provides a detailed report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to commit code, see who changed a line, or tidy up Git history. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless you explicitly ask for Git work.

say_en.text: Commit these changes as two atomic commits.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze changes and split into multiple commits.

say_en.text: Who last modified lines 10-20 of src/main.js?
say_en.note: Claude will use git blame to find the author.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Claude will perform interactive rebase and auto-squash.
